Interface PytestTestListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
JUnitPytestTestListener
public interface PytestTestListener
Listener interface for pytest test execution events. This interface allows Java code to receive notifications about pytest test execution.

  • Method Details

    • onOutput

      void onOutput(String testId, String stream, String text)
      Forward per-test output captured by the pytest plugin.
      Parameters:
      testId - pytest nodeid (e.g. path/to/test.py::test_name)
      stream - one of "stdout", "stderr" or "log"
      text - full text captured for this test phase

    • drainConsoleOutput

      default String drainConsoleOutput(String testId, String stream)
      Take console output written through the Java standard streams (for example application logging) since the previous call, so the pytest plugin can attach it to the current test phase as a report section.
      Parameters:
      testId - pytest nodeid of the running test
      stream - one of "stdout" or "stderr"
      Returns:
      the captured text, or null when console output is not being captured

    • stashSessionConsoleOutput

      default void stashSessionConsoleOutput()
      Mark the end of the session bootstrap: console output written so far (test session banner, application startup logging) belongs to the session rather than to the first test that runs.
